$comment: Flip2 manager profiles. Canonical copy; wizard/profiles.json must stay byte-identical so the page can fetch it. Component ids match pipeline/deploy/manifest.json, plus whisper and vosk (speech files, not manifest components).

profiles.label: Base
profiles.summary: Today's full wizard install: modules, Launcher4, Null Keyboard, Forkgram, Material Files, Intertune, Bouncy, home keys, 321×428, wallpaper, Whisper, and Vosk.

profiles.label: Managed
profiles.summary: Base plus Headwind MDM launcher (15400) and Where (net.af0.where_1404). Apply before device owner; see docs/MANAGED-MDM-SETUP.md.
profiles.warning: Device owner is not part of Apply. It needs a user with no accounts; factory reset stays on the phone. This app never wipes userdata over USB. If accounts exist, back up to ~/flip2-pre-wipe-backup and reset on the phone before typing manage.

profiles.label: Secure
profiles.reason: The GrapheneLite/GraphineLite branch is not in this repo.
